**What operating system (Linux, Windows, ...) and version?**
Windows 10 22H2
**What runtime / compiler are you using (e.g., python version or gcc version)**
Visual Studio 2022
**What did you do?**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

The "Any" type fields do not accept null values for packing; only an empty object instantiated with new Any() can be passed to represent a null value. 
An empty "Any" object is represented as {"@type": "", "@value": ""}. 
The current C# JsonFormatter and JsonParser both do not accept this input value, and both throw an error: Type registry has no descriptor for type name ''.

For example: 

            var rep = new MsgFromProtoFile(); // IMessage instance
            rep.SomeAnyField = Any.Pack(new MyAnyField{ strField= "string", 
                anyField= new Any() // empty Any object, this will be {"@type": "", "@value": ""}
            });

            var tr = TypeRegistry.FromMessages(MyAnyField.Descriptor);
            var json_parser = new JsonParser(JsonParser.Settings.Default.WithTypeRegistry(tr));

nodes.body:
This is an issue with these two projects.
* [python-etcd3](https://github.com/kragniz/python-etcd3) provides a precompiled module etcd3/etcdrpc/rpc_pb2.py which refers to the original file as "rpc.proto", with no directory.

One of them (both, ideally) should compile the modules with a directory prefix.
Let's continue the discussion on https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/issues/19106

nodes.body: Hey @nick-lawrence-ctm,  does this repro on latest (4.29.3)?

No, that version is able to install successfully
```
$ ruby --version
ruby 3.4.1 (2024-12-25 revision 48d4efcb85) +PRISM [aarch64-linux]

$ gem install google-protobuf
Defaulting to user installation because default installation directory (/usr/lib64/ruby/gems/3.4.0) is not writable.
Successfully installed google-protobuf-4.29.3-aarch64-linux
1 gem installed
```

However, our project has dependencies for earlier versions of google-protobuf. For example, 
```
google-ads-googleads (31.0.0)
      gapic-common (>= 0.21.1, < 1.0)
      google-protobuf (>= 3.19.4, < 4.0)
```

Aight should be fixed with https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/pull/19952

Keep an eye out for our next release and don't hesitate to reach out if anything is amiss. Thanks!

Thank you so much for assisting me in resolving the issue!!!

title: Tracking Edition 2024 Readiness
body:
Is there any issue or discussion where we can follow this progress?

The best I have found is a mention of "early 2025" [here](https://github.com/golang/protobuf/issues/513#issuecomment-2399359519).

It will be helpful to know if we can just wait a short while to get the helpful features like `strip_enum_prefix` which can massively shrink our changesets when transitioning off of gogoproto, otherwise we will just push forward without.

title: cut 3.25.6 release?
body:
Is it possible to cut a new version of the 3.x chain to include this recently merged fix: https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/issues/19938

And/or is it possible to provide a recommendation on how to bundle this fix direct from github?  This repo is non-standard since it has nested folders and makes that difficult (or impossible).  Thank you!

title: Export `go_features_proto` tag
body:
<!--

NOTE: this form is for feature requests (including cleanup requests) only. For questions or troubleshooting, please see the protobuf mailing list: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/protobuf

-->


**What language does this apply to?**
Bazel

**Describe the problem you are trying to solve.**
I'd like to use the Opaque API for the go generated code in a project managed with Bazel.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Make the tag public or create an alias in the root. This way I can add `go_features_proto` to the dependencies.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Vendor the file

**Additional context**
Aliases are exported for Java https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/blob/main/BUILD.bazel#L386-L390 and C++ https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/blob/main/BUILD.bazel#L346-L350
